Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-english-main-0-transcribe-medium-0172-reverse-02", "row_sha256": "17c929ba4dc13250e4d1c08ec40092e5cfc7e2742af7fc2f0e2c49d6065f7b82", "mode": "/transcribe", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Remove true hesitation and accidental restarts. Apply explicit corrections to the final stated intent. Preserve meaningful filler-like words and unfinished thoughts. Apply clearly spoken punctuation and list cues. Keep the supplied language.", "input": "on tuesday morning i joined the access team for a screen reader audit of the new checkout page at harbor market the test account had a saved grocery order and a delivery fee the receipt showed a total of 161.98 not 46.71 i read the amount aloud while maya checked the screen reader output the first pass announced the item names and quantities in the right order but skipped the fee label we changed the label text and ran the same order again the screen reader then announced delivery fee before the total and said the amount clearly i also checked the payment summary and the confirmation page both showed the same total we tested with the display set to large text and with the screen reader voice slowed down the total remained visible without covering the order button the team noted that the lower amount belonged to an older test receipt and was not the total for this audit i saved the test steps and the recording in the shared folder before closing the session", "output": "On Tuesday morning, I joined the access team for a screen reader audit of the new checkout page at Harbor Market. The test account had a saved grocery order and a delivery fee. The receipt showed a total of 161.98, not 46.71. I read the amount aloud while Maya checked the screen reader output. The first pass announced the item names and quantities in the right order but skipped the fee label. We changed the label text and ran the same order again. The screen reader then announced delivery fee before the total and said the amount clearly. I also checked the payment summary and the confirmation page; both showed the same total. We tested with the display set to large text and with the screen reader voice slowed down. The total remained visible without covering the order button. The team noted that the lower amount belonged to an older test receipt and was not the total for this audit. I saved the test steps and the recording in the shared folder before closing the session."}]
